item.title: 【Live Audios (lossless)】FLAC - Zipangu Festival @ Brookside Park 2026-05-16 (ADO + Yuki Chiba + ATARASHII GAKKO! + MAN WITH A MISSION + Chanmina + 10-FEET + HANA
item.description:
Hidden Content:
You must either reply or click 'Like' to see the hidden information contained here.
The bands, who had little in common other than being from Japan were a lot of fun. Not too crowded and one stage with no conflict already puts this way ahead of any festival I have seen here. Loved HANA, Chanmina and ATARASHII GAKKO! ADO was a silhouette in a cage and not sure if she was a real person or some kind of AI trick.
